title: Gaussian process model on self-reported symptoms predicts COVID-19 in the UK
summary: On a temporal test set of 15,049 after training on 182,991 users, AUC was 0.80 versus 0.74 for logistic regression and 0.67 for the NHS algorithm. The test split comes from the same app and relies on self-report.
ai_technology: Hierarchical Gaussian process model on self-reported symptoms

evidence.tested: Temporal test set of 15,049 after 182,991 training
evidence.unknown: Temporal split from same app; self-report; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Hierarchical Gaussian process on self-reported symptoms predicts COVID-19 infection
